meta.name: content-repurposing
meta.description: Use when the user wants to turn public social videos, transcripts, posts, or creator research into reusable content assets such as LinkedIn posts, X threads, short-form scripts, newsletters, blog outlines, carousels, or content calendars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将公开视频、帖子和访谈改写成各平台营销内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你手头有视频或帖子,想快速变成多平台营销内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn public videos and posts into multi-platform marketing assets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have existing videos or posts and want to repurpose them for multiple channels.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把用户提供的视频、字幕、帖子或调研材料拆成可复用的内容原子（开头、故事、观点等），再按各平台要求改写成 LinkedIn 帖、X 线程、短视频脚本、newsletter 或博客大纲，并保留来源标注。
howto.when: 当用户给出视频、字幕、帖子链接或调研报告，并要求把内容改写成帖子、脚本、newsletter、博客大纲或内容日历等时触发。

say.text: 把这个长视频字幕改成一条 LinkedIn 帖子和三段短视频脚本
say.note: 会按来源拆出内容原子并输出可粘贴草稿

say.text: 根据我的口播逐字稿生成一篇 newsletter 大纲和一条 X 线程
say.note: 会按平台差异改写并标注灵感来源

say.text: 把这条 TikTok 的亮点做成内容日历里的五个选题
say.note: 会提取开头、数据点等并排成日历

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude turns provided videos, transcripts, posts, or research into reusable content atoms (hooks, stories, claims, data), then rewrites them for LinkedIn, X, short-form scripts, newsletters, or blog outlines, keeping source attribution.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user supplies a video, transcript, post, or research report and asks to turn it into posts, scripts, newsletters, blog outlines, or a content calendar.

say_en.text: Turn this long video transcript into a LinkedIn post and three short-form scripts.
say_en.note: It extracts content atoms and outputs paste-ready drafts.

say_en.text: Generate a newsletter outline and an X thread from my spoken transcript.
say_en.note: It rewrites per platform and notes the source.

say_en.text: Turn the highlights of this TikTok into five content-calendar topics.
say_en.note: It pulls hooks, data points, etc., and schedules them.
